children: TORONTO, Sept. 15, 2026 /CNW/ -- First Capital REIT ("First Capital") (TSX: FCR.UN) announced today that it will make a cash distribution of $0.076 per REIT unit for the month of September, representing $0.912 per REIT unit on an annualized basis. The distribution will be paid on October 15, 2026, to unitholders of record as at September 30, 2026.
First Capital owns and operates, acquires, and develops open-air grocery-anchored shopping centres in neighbourhoods with the strongest demographics in Canada.
